test_title: PYST 14: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 10 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)

question: The cost price of a calculator is ₹315. If the profit percentage is 20%, then what is the value (in ₹) of the profit?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit is directly calculated as a percentage of the Cost Price.

Profit = 20% of CP

Profit = ¹/₅ × 315

Profit = 63

**∴ The correct answer is ₹63.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = ₹315

Profit Percentage = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Profit = (Profit% ÷ 100) &time
